scope: Named AAOI diagnostic model repair, not broad survivor-only screening
objective: same original completed-close to 10-session-close log return / RV20 sqrt10; current intraday entry NOT calibrated
evaluation: Same original 85 nonoverlapping dates from 2023, labels maturity j+10<=signal; no choose-best deployment

geometry_definition.left_selection: most recent earlier confirmed local minimum within separation bounds; no outcome-dependent selection
geometry_definition.no_W: present=0 and structure numeric slots=0 means absent pattern, not imputed unknown market factors

model.whitening: training-only 80% covariance +20% diagonal covariance; symmetric eigen inverse sqrt, no result tuned weights

execution_diagnostics: completed-minute VWAP, last30m return and relative return, last30m/previous30m volume, 5m high/low improvement, timestamps; not part of daily fit or current win probability
